`aid lint` and `aid fmt` dispatch to four tools. Each tool looks for its own config file, starting in the target directory and walking up until it reaches a directory that holds `.git`. Without one, the bundled default below applies.

| Tool | Files | Config files |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `md` | `**/*.md`, `**/*.markdown` | `.markdownlint.json`, `.markdownlint.jsonc`, `.markdownlint.yaml`, `.markdownlint.yml` |
| `openapi` | `**/openapi.{yaml,yml,json}`, `**/*.openapi.{yaml,yml,json}`, `**/openapi/**/*.{yaml,yml,json}` | `.spectral.yaml`, `.spectral.yml`, `.spectral.json` |
| `biome` | `**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx,mjs,cjs,json,jsonc,css}` | `biome.json`, `biome.jsonc` |
| `proto` | `**/*.proto` | `buf.yaml` |

Discovery never walks into these directories: `node_modules`, `dist`, `.bun`, `.git`, `.turbo`, `build`, `coverage`, `.next`, `.cache`, `.vercel`.

## markdownlint default (`md`)

```json
{
  "default": true,
  "MD013": false,
  "MD024": {
    "siblings_only": true
  },
  "MD041": false
}
```

## Spectral default (`openapi`)

The bundled ruleset is `spectral:oas`.

## Biome default (`biome`)

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://biomejs.dev/schemas/2.4.15/schema.json",
  "formatter": {
    "enabled": true,
    "indentStyle": "space",
    "indentWidth": 2,
    "lineWidth": 100,
    "lineEnding": "lf"
  },
  "javascript": {
    "formatter": {
      "quoteStyle": "double",
      "jsxQuoteStyle": "double",
      "semicolons": "asNeeded",
      "trailingCommas": "all",
      "bracketSpacing": true,
      "arrowParentheses": "always"
    }
  },
  "css": {
    "parser": {
      "tailwindDirectives": true
    }
  },
  "linter": {
    "enabled": true,
    "rules": {
      "recommended": true
    }
  }
}
```

## buf default (`proto`)

```yaml
version: v2
lint:
  use:
    - STANDARD
```
